why: 7333 -> 7562, +229 bytes, no new exported symbol. `typeInto` learned to edit at the
caret instead of appending: it splices at an index the engine reports, clamps that
index rather than trusting a number that crossed a process boundary, and slices by
*characters* rather than UTF-16 units so a caret between an emoji and the next letter
cannot cut a surrogate pair in half.
Raised rather than avoided, and the alternatives were measured, not assumed. Appending
is what it did before and is simply wrong — clicking into the middle of a field and
typing put the characters at the end. Slicing by `.length` is smaller and breaks on
any astral character. A first pass spread the array four times and cost 246 bytes;
hoisting the tail and dropping the extra spreads got 17 of them back, which is all
What did *not* grow is the shape: no new export, and nothing per frame. The caret
index, its blink and every movement key live in the engine (`caret.rs`), so an arrow
key costs no runtime bytes and no round trip at all — this 229 is the whole price of
the feature on the Bun side.
